questions.question: What circuitry was used in first generation computers (1940-1959)?
What was the size of first generation computers (1940-1959)?
Which of the following describes first generation computers (1940-1959)?
options: Increased storage capacity and high-level programming languages
Limited storage capacity, slow speed, and a problem of overheating
Modular design and increased use of microcomputers
questions.correctAnswer: Limited storage capacity, slow speed, and a problem of overheating

questions.question: What circuitry was used in second generation computers (1959-1964)?
What high-level programming languages appeared during the second generation of computers?
Which improvements were made by second generation computers compared to the first generation?
options: Increased storage capacity and reduction in size and heat
Room size mainframes and vacuum tubes
questions.correctAnswer: Increased storage capacity and reduction in size and heat

questions.question: What circuitry was used in third generation computers (1965-1970)?
What was the size of third generation computers (1965-1970)?
Which features describe third generation computers (1965-1970)?
options: More flexible with input/output, smaller size, and better performance
Slow speed and limited storage capacity
questions.correctAnswer: More flexible with input/output, smaller size, and better performance

questions.question: What circuitry is used in fourth generation computers (since 1970)?
Which of the following describes fourth generation computers (since 1970)?
options: Limited storage capacity and slow speed
Artificial intelligence as their main feature
Problem of overheating and room size design
Increased storage, modular design versatility and compatibility, and increased use of microcomputers (PCs)
questions.correctAnswer: Increased storage, modular design versatility and compatibility, and increased use of microcomputers (PCs)

questions.question: What circuitry is expected in the fifth generation (future) computers?
Which technologies will characterize the fifth generation (future) computers?
options: Modular design and increased PC use

questions.question: True or False: The first generation of computers used transistors.
True or False: COBOL and FORTRAN are high-level programming languages that appeared in the second generation of computers.
True or False: The fourth generation of computers uses very large scale integrated (VLSI) circuits.
True or False: Fifth generation (future) computers will be characterized by artificial intelligence and robotics.
What is the overall trend across the generations of computers?
options: Each generation is smaller, faster, and more efficient
Each generation becomes larger and slower
Each generation needs more cooling and space
questions.correctAnswer: Each generation is smaller, faster, and more efficient
